translate_en|mods/BloodlustOverwhelming/: The craving for a kill is overwhelming, may the next soul you see rest in peace
You're dying. All that matters now is killing until your last breath.
Next one goes to grave with you.
Your body burns itself for killing, fueled by the death
One strike is all it takes.
The battle is fading, and so is your borrowed energy
You're collapsing from all the pain you've been ignoring
Every limit you've stretched to kill just a bit more is ripping through your body
Time to pay for every second you thought you could keep going
You're burning more energy than you have, but you won't feel it until you stop fighting
You lost touch with reality on how exhausted you really are, killing is all that matters
Your body is screaming past its limits... Too bad you couldn't care less right now
Your body has been running on pure bloodlust... It won't hold much longer
Why aren't you fighting? Kill them all!
You burned more than just your bloodlust
Bursts of overwhelming power take a toll on your body
Every surge of impossible strength is finally destroying you
Your monstrous power comes with monstrous backlash
You're itching for a fight, feeling so wrong without killing

Once you land a hit with this much bloodlust accumulated, you'll instantly enter frenzy regardless of your bloodiness.

Note that your current bloodlust level is added to this value.
Whether high bloodlust increases chance to lose weapon condition on hit, while also adding more Maintenance experience.
Whether to deal additional damage for hits with bare hands.
Whether to deal additional damage when shooting with firearms.
Whether your bloodlust level may change how much damage you take.

How much bloodlust is suppressed as result of taking antidepressants. It can be stacked.

Bloodlust is suppressed gradually as antidepressants kick in (uses fade in time).

How many game world minutes antidepressants effects last.

1020 is 17 hours.

How many game world minutes it takes for the antidepressants effect to reach maximum intensity.
In vanilla they start to reduce unhappiness only after 2 hours.

This many minutes before the base duration runs out, the antidepressants effects start to decline.
This is counted from base duration; e.g. with duration of 1020 and fade out time of 360,
Intensity of intrusive thoughts is multiplied by this while antidepressants are active.

Modifier for bloodlust increase due to kill craving while antidepressants are active.

0.1 means your bloodlust increases only at 10%% rate.

Modifier for bloodlust increase/decrease on hits and kills while antidepressants are active.

0.5 means they change your bloodlust by only 50%% of normal rate.

Doesn't affect bloodlust reduced by instakills.

Modifier for mood debuffs due to kill craving while antidepressants are active.

0.1 means your bloodlust increases only at 10%% rate.
Intensity of vision redness is multiplied by this while antidepressants are active.

How much bloodlust is suppressed as result of taking beta blockers. It can be stacked.

Bloodlust is suppressed gradually as beta blockers kick in (uses fade in time).

How many game world minutes beta blockers effects last.

600 is 10 hours.

How many game world minutes it takes for the beta blockers effect to reach maximum intensity.
In vanilla they start to reduce unhappiness only after 2 hours.

This many minutes before the base duration runs out, the beta blockers effects start to decline.
This is counted from base duration; e.g. with duration of 1020 and fade out time of 360,

Modifier for bloodlust increase due to kill craving while beta blockers are active.

0.1 means your bloodlust increases only at 10%% rate.

Modifier for bloodlust increase/decrease on hits and kills while beta blockers are active.

0.4 means they change your bloodlust by only 40%% of normal rate.

Doesn't affect bloodlust reduced by instakills.
Beta Blockers Loss Of Control Modifier

Modifier for loss of control chances and progression while beta blockers are active.

0.25 basically means you'll lose control only 25%% as often.

How much active beta-blockers reduce the chance of your character shouting on bloodlust actions, e.g. instakills.
(Without mindfulness or beta-blockers the chance is always 100%%)

Note that this modifier, like all others, is reached smoothly as beta blockers kick in (fade in time).

Also note that this doesn't affect loss of control phrases, as they are purely informational and don't attract zombies.
Minimum overall bloodiness for a kill to be scored as bloody.

How bloody overall you must be to start progressing towards frenzy.

You may set this beyond 100%% if you intend to require at least some freshness.

Determines how strongly bloodiness freshness accelerates progress toward frenzy.

At 4, 50%% freshness doubles the rate of frenzy progression, while 100%% freshness quadruples it.

How much bloodiness freshness makes bloodiness count as more.

0.5 means 100%% freshness counts like +50%% more of bloodiness.

How much your bloodiness reduces the time it takes to reach 100%% unhappiness/stress/boredom.

0.5 means 50%% quicker worst mood if 100%% bloody.

How much additional damage to deal at instakill bloodlust level in frenzy.

The bonus increases smoothly as bloodlust rises, reaching the value you set at the bloodlust level required for instakill.

With bloodlust required for instakill set to 90 and default additional damage of 0.75,
you'll deal 0.75 bonus damage at 90 bloodlust, 0.375 at 45 bloodlust, etc.

Max zombie health is 2.0.

How much additional damage to deal at instakill bloodlust level.

The bonus increases smoothly as bloodlust rises, reaching the value you set at the bloodlust level required for instakill.

With bloodlust required for instakill set to 90 and default additional damage of 0.5,
you'll deal 0.5 bonus damage at 90 bloodlust, 0.25 at 45 bloodlust, etc.

Max zombie health is 2.0.

Proportion of bloodlust change from hits/kills to add as stress reduction.

With 5, it'll take 20 bloodlust increased/decreased to go from 100%% stress to absolute chill.

Proportion of bloodlust change from hits/kills to add as unhappiness reduction.

With 2, it'll take 50 bloodlust increased/decreased to go from depression to happiness.

Maximum multiplier for the chance to lose weapon condition on hit.

It multiplies whatever your current chance to lose weapon durability is (base weapon chance + maintenance correction).
Ex. if you have 0 skills and weapon base chance is 10%%, 1.5 multiplier turns it into 15%%.

The multiplier smoothly increases starting from 1.0 to this value as bloodlust rises, reaching the set multiplier at 100%% bloodlust.

Minimum bloodlust to start buffering exertion at.

Note that in frenzy your exertion is always buffered.

You won't panic when above this bloodlust.

You'll also recover from panic significantly faster the closer you are to immunity.

Bloodlust after which unhappiness, stress and boredom starts to increase if you aren't fighting.

The increase starts small, and reaches its maximum at 100%% bloodlust.
You must reduce this much bloodlust (via hits/kills) while having no bloodlust to go into frenzy.

Whether bloodlust reduced as result of taking pills, curling up, or hugging the plushie is remembered.
Disabling this also disabled bloodlust accumulation as result of meditation.
Bloody kills will decay every hour at this bloodiness.
Whether to decay bloody kills while you're sleeping.
How many bloody kills are removed every hour if you're not bloody.
How many bloody kills it takes to earn the trait.

Once you reach this level of exertion, start passively storing it.

25 is when first exertion moodle "Out of Breath" appears.
Chance To Stop Death Rampage On Kill

Percentage chance to recover from death rampage on kill.

With 0.56%% chance, it'll take you ~180 kills on average to recover.
Given -0.55 health every minute in combat that's 1 kill every single minute.

Multiplier for the bonus experience you get for increased chance to lose condition.

If your current condition loss multiplier is 2.0, you'll get twice the experience on each hit,
which is then multiplied by this number.

So 0.6 means you get 60%% of the bonus experience.

Note that in vanilla you get experience only half of the time (50%% chance), 0.5 xp multiplier kinda simulates that.
Consider Car Drive Over As Combat
Whether killing zombies by driving over them is considered as hits (Used for fightless combat bloodlust increase).
Consider Shoves And Stomps As Hits
Whether shoving and stomping are considered as hits (Used for fightless combat bloodlust increase).

Whether to allow loss of control events to attack NPCs.

Note that this also means aiming at NPCs within your attack range may trigger Attacking outburst.

If "Go To NPCs" is disabled, attacking is only possible if an NPC happens to be in your attack range.

Base swing speed bonus during Attacking outburst, when there is no progress towards Locked In.

0.4 means +40%% speed.

Movement speed bonus during Attacking outburst while aiming.

0.3 means +30%% speed.

Movement speed bonus during Attacking outburst.

0.1 means +10%% speed.

Doesn't apply to aiming - it has its own bonus below.

When you're already experiencing Following outburst, adds this much to Attacking chance.
Note that the final chance still depends on bloodlust level.

When you're already experiencing Tracking outburst, adds this much to Attacking chance.
Note that the final chance still depends on bloodlust level.

The chance for Attacking outburst to occur.

Tested every "Targeting Test Every" real seconds,
after you don't attack a zombie within your range while aiming for "Attacking Targeting Time" real seconds.

The chance will start at 0%% at min bloodlust, then increase linearly up to this value at max bloodlust.

Whether to force equip a melee weapon if you're not holding one.
Otherwise Attacking outburst will end.
Maximum real seconds you'll be forced to aim when Attacking outburst occurs.
Minimum real seconds you'll be forced to aim when Attacking outburst occurs.

Flat attack range bonus for involuntary attacks during Attacking outburst.

ONLY FOR INVOLUNTARY SWINGS! Does not apply to you hitting manually.

1 means involuntary attacks can hit 1 tiles farther.
Bloodlust level at which max Attacking chance is reached.
Maximum involuntarily swings Attacking will last for.
Bloodlust level above which Attacking may occur.
Minimum involuntarily swings Attacking will last for.
Whether there is a chance for your character to start attacking without your input.

Swing speed bonus during Attacking outburst at 100%% Locked In progress.

Actual swing speed is increased smoothly up to this value as you get closer to Locked In.

0.8 means +80%% speed.
Once Attacking Targeting Time is reached, the chance is tested every time this many real seconds pass.
When you don't attack a zombie for this much time while aiming at it (given you can hit it), Attacking outburst has a chance to occur.
Can Go To Sleep Right After Nightmare

Whether to allow going right back to sleeping after having a nightmare.
Otherwise, vanilla rules apply - you won't be able to sleep for an hour after waking up.
Check whether failed targets can be reached every this many real seconds.
Maximum real seconds active phase may last for.
Minimum real seconds active phase may last for.
Following Active Min Tiles From Zombie
How many tiles away a closest zombie must be for active following phase.
Maximum real seconds you must be inactive for idle following to start.
Minimum real seconds you must be inactive for idle following to start.
Chance to immediately start Tracking when Following ends.
Following Idle Min Tiles From Zombie
How many tiles away a closest zombie must be for idle following phase.
Bloodlust level at which max following chance is reached.
Maximum in-game minutes following may last.
Bloodlust level above which following may occur.
Minimum in-game minutes following may last.
Following Movement Attempt Moves For Seconds
During active phase, pressing a movement key will keep you moving towards closest zombie for this many seconds after the key is released.

Your character may walk towards a zombie. Consists of two phases:
1. Active: Any movement input moves you towards closest zombie.
2. Idle: You move towards closest zombie if you're idle.
Forget zombies/squares that you weren't able to go to after this many real minutes.

Whether to allow loss of control events to go to NPCs.

Enabling this forces "Attack NPCs" to be on, since otherwise you'll be stuck hugging an NPC during loss of control.
Involuntary Hit To Locked In Max Progress

Maximum progress to add for each involuntary swing that lands during Attacking outburst.
Upon reaching 100 you'll get Locked In.
Involuntary Hit To Locked In Min Progress

Minimum progress to add for each involuntary swing that lands during Attacking outburst.
Upon reaching 100 you'll get Locked In.
Involuntary Hit To Locked In Progress Decay After
After this many real seconds pass since last involuntary hit, start decaying the progress towards Locked In.
Involuntary Hit To Locked In Progress Decay Per Second
How much progress towards Locked In to remove every in-game world minute after you stop letting your character attack on their own.
Going this many tiles away from closest zombie may trigger Kill Blink.
Kill Blink Force Aim Max Time
Maximum time you'll be forced to aim after kill blink.
Kill Blink Force Aim Min Time
Minimum time you'll be forced to aim after kill blink.
All zombies will be knocked down within tiles around you when Kill Blink happens.
Kill blink target must have no other zombies within this many tiles.
Bloodlust level at which max Kill Blink chance is reached.

The chance for Kill Blink outburst to occur.

Tested every game minute, but only if you've gone at least "Kill Blink Distance Trigger" tiles away from closest zombie.
Bloodlust level above which Kill Blink may occur.
You must be at least this many tiles away from zombies for Kill Blink to be possible.
Whether it's possible for you to blink... and realize you just killed a zombie in a different place.
For how long you'll be forced to stop and stare and the now dead zombie you just kill-blinked to.
Kill Blink Untouchable Period After Stop
Once Kill Blink happens, for this many real seconds zombies will be unable to hit you.

Movement speed bonus during Locked In outburst.

0.05 means +5%% speed.

Swing speed bonus during Locked In outburst.

0.7 means +70%% speed.
Locked In Buffered Exertion To Stop
Percentage of exertion buffer fullness after which Locked In will be stopped.

Whether to force equip a melee weapon if you're not holding one.
Otherwise Locked In outburst will end.
Locked In Forced Movement Only If Can See Zombie
Whether you'll only be forced into killing if you can see closest zombie.
Locked In Forced Movement Zombie Distance

While Locked In, getting this close to a zombie will force you to kill it - character will move and attack on their own.
Note that this behavior is also forced if a zombie gets within your attack range.
Locked In Hurt Knock Down Chance
Percentage of zombies that will be knocked down when you get hurt while Locked In.
Zombies within this many tiles to player will be pushed back when you get hurt while Locked In.
Maximum number of zombies pushed back when you get hurt while Locked In.

Flat attack range bonus for involuntary attacks during Locked In outburst.

1.5 means involuntary attacks can hit 1.5 tiles farther.
If your exertion buffer is this percentage full, Locked In won't begin.
Locked In Max Idle Time To Go
Maximum real seconds that must pass since you moved for character to start going towards zombies while Locked In.
Maximum kill count to stop Locked In.
Locked In Min Idle Time To Go
Minimum real seconds that must pass since you moved for character to start going towards zombies while Locked In.
Minimum kill count to stop Locked In.

You'll always swing at least this fast while Locked In, no matter the injuries and endurance.

Vanilla range is 0.8 to 1.6.

Whether letting yourself be consumed by Attacking outburst may result in losing control over your movement as well.
The character will find and kill zombies on their own.
Can only happen in frenzy.
While Locked In and further than this many tiles from a zombie, the character will run when going for them.
Locked In Shove Knock Down Chance
Percentage of zombies that will be knocked down when you shove while Locked In.
Zombies within this many tiles to player will be pushed back when you shove while Locked In.
Maximum number of zombies pushed back when you shove while Locked In.

When you get forced to go kill a zombie, for this many seconds the character will just stand still, staring at it.
The character will still attack immediately once the zombie is within attack range.

Real seconds between checking whether your character seems to be unable to reach any zombies, which would end Locked In.

Only checked if all targets were unreachable and you can't control your movement.
Locked In Stuck If No Clear Zombies Only
Whether you won't be considered stuck if there is any zombie you can see and go to in straight line without any obstacles.
Locked In Stuck If Not Hit For
Consider the character stuck if they haven't attacked for this many seconds while not under your control.
Locked In Untouchable Period After Stop
Once Locked In outburst ends and you regain control, for this many real seconds zombies will be unable to hit you.

Whether it's possible for your character to act on their own at high bloodlust.

This is a global toggle for all loss of control / outburst events.

Having more than this muscle strain on any of your arms will stop only Locked In.
But it'll only stop after all other parts have full strain, thus making redistribution to them impossible.

If your body temperature is higher than this, stop outbursts.
See https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Hyperthermia

Having more than this exertion will stop outbursts.
See https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Endurance

Having more than this fatigue will stop outbursts.
See https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Tired

Having more than this hunger will stop outbursts.
70 is when you start starving to death.
Maximum distance in tiles to kill blink target.
Max Minutes Out Of Combat To Stop Attacking
Maximum in-game world minutes that must pass since you went out of combat to stop Attacking.

Zombies the character can go to must be at least within this many tiles.

Actual tiles travelled might be more because of obstacles - this is just a straight-line distance measure.

Having more than this sickness will stop outbursts.
10 poison is when you start taking poison damage.
Max Seconds Since Hit To Stop Locked In
Maximum real seconds that must pass without your character attacking anyone to stop Locked In.

Having more than this sickness will stop outbursts.
Fever and damage starts at 90.

Having more than this thirst will stop outbursts.
85 is when you start dying of thirst.
Max Zombies Nearby To Lock In
If there are more than this zombies within "Zombies Nearby Tiles" (See "Bloodlust Overwhelming" tab), don't start Locked In.

If your body temperature is less than this, stop outbursts.
See https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Hypothermia
Having your health less than this will stop outbursts.
Minimum distance in tiles to kill blink target.
Min Minutes Out Of Combat To Stop Attacking
Minimum in-game world minutes that must pass since you went out of combat to stop Attacking.
Min Seconds Since Hit To Stop Locked In
Minimum real seconds that must pass without your character attacking anyone to stop Locked In.
Minimum in-game hours the character must sleep for before a nightmare can occur.
How much fatigue is added (positive) or removed (negative) when bloodlust nightmare occurs.
Chance to play zombie surprise sound when waking up due to having a nightmare from bloodlust.
Bloodlust level at which max nightmare chance is reached.

Maximum chance for nightmare to occur, tested every in-game minute while sleeping.

The chance will start at 0%% at min bloodlust, then increase linearly up to this value at max bloodlust.
Suppressed bloodlust at which max additional nightmare chance is reached.
Bloodlust level above which nightmare may occur.
Suppressed bloodlust additional nightmares chance starts at.

How much stress is added (positive) or removed (negative) when bloodlust nightmare occurs.
(Vanilla nightmares add 50 stress)
How much of suppressed bloodlust is still counted towards Nightmare chance.
Maximum additional chance for nightmare to occur, tested every in-game minute while sleeping.

Chance for bloodlust nightmare to resolve into following outburst.
(Bloodlust must be above the minimum required for Following.)

Tested before Tracking, and if succeeded won't be overwritten by it.

Chance for bloodlust nightmare to resolve into tracking outburst.
(Bloodlust must be above the minimum required for Tracking.)

Tested only if Following chance failed.
How much unhappiness is added (positive) or removed (negative) when bloodlust nightmare occurs.

Whether nightmares can happen when sleeping in a vehicle.
The character will forcefully exit it when waking up.
Whether there is a chance to have a special nightmare while sleeping at high bloodlust.
Real milliseconds between redoing pathing when you're already going to someone.
When Locked in, any muscle strain above this on arm parts will be moved to other parts of your body, as long as they aren't fully stiff already.
Start Tracking After Idle When Locked In
Once this percentage of idle time passes, the character will turn towards closest zombie.
Start Tracking After Inactivity When Following
Once this percentage of inactivity time passes, the character will turn towards closest zombie.
Whether to stop outbursts if you have a neck injury of any type that is bleeding, or isn't bandaged or the bandage is dirty.
At this distance to zombies, the modifier starts to gradually take effect.
At this distance to zombies, the modifier reaches its configured value.

How much of suppressed bloodlust is still counted towards loss of control chances.

0.2 means 20%% of suppressed bloodlust is counted.
Tracking Idle Time If Near Vehicle
Adds this many seconds to idle time that must pass if you're near a car.
Bloodlust level at which max tracking chance is reached.

Maximum chance for tracking to occur, tested every in-game minute.

The chance will start at 0%% at min bloodlust, then increase linearly up to this value at max bloodlust.
Maximum idle time that must pass before the character will turn towards zombies when Tracking.
Maximum in-game minutes tracking may last.
Bloodlust level above which tracking may occur.
Closest zombie that you cannot see must be this many tiles away from you for tracking to occur.
Minimum idle time that must pass before the character will turn towards zombies when Tracking.
Minimum in-game minutes tracking may last.
Closest zombie that you can see must be this many tiles away from you for tracking to occur.
Tracking Movement Lock Min Tiles From Zombie
Minimum tiles to closest zombie for tracking movement lock to happen.
When tracking occurs, for how many real seconds you won't be able to control your character as it stands still, looking in direction of closest zombie.

Your character may turn to face a zombie. Consists of two phases:
1. Movement Lock: You cannot move or look away.
2. Idle: Your character will turn towards zombie when you stand still for a bit.
How many real seconds since last player activity must pass for tracking to occur.
Chance to stop tracking when you're aiming, tested every in-game world minute.
Tracking Stop If Zombie Within Tiles
Once tracking is active, if closest zombie is visible and is closer than this many tiles, don't track it.

Maximum chance for Tracking to evolve into Following, tested every in-game minute, if player is moving.

The chance will start at 0%% at min bloodlust, then increase linearly up to this value at max bloodlust.
Tracking To Following Min Tiles From Hidden Zombie
Minimum distance zombie you don't see must be for Tracking to evolve into Following.
Tracking To Following Min Tiles From Visible Zombie
Minimum distance visible zombie must be for Tracking to evolve into Following.

If "Curl Up Bloodlust Per Minute" is negative, this is the minimum bloodlust below which curling up won't reduce bloodlust.
Otherwise, this is the maximum bloodlust above which curling up won't add bloodlust.

How much bloodlust to remove (negative) or add (positive) every game world minute while you're curled up.
Note that removing bloodlust counts as bloodlust suppression and will have consequences.
Curl Up Kill Craving Bloodlust Modifier

Modifier for bloodlust increase due to kill craving while curled up.

0.2 means your bloodlust increases only at 20%% rate.
Death Rampage Combat Health Per Minute

How much health is added (positive) or removed (negative) every minute in combat on death rampage.

-0.55 means you'll live for up to ~3 hours if you're in combat the whole time.

Frenzy bonus damage is multiplied by this number on death rampage.

1.0 means no change, 0.0 means remove the bonus completely, 0.5 to reduce it to 50%%, 2.0 to double it, etc.
Death Rampage Hurt Knock Down Chance
Percentage of zombies that will be knocked down when you get hit while on death rampage.
Zombies within this many tiles to player will be pushed back when you get hit while on death rampage.
Maximum number of zombies pushed back when you get hit while on death rampage.

Frenzy bonus movement speed is multiplied by this number on death rampage.

1.0 means no change, 0.0 means remove the bonus completely, 0.5 to reduce it to 50%%, 2.0 to double it, etc.
Whether you go into death rampage when dying to "Drag Down".
Death Rampage Out Of Combat Health Per Minute

How much health is added (positive) or removed (negative) every minute out of combat on death rampage.

-3.33 means you're guaranteed to die within ~30 minutes out of combat.

Radius of all sounds emitted by this mod (e.g. on instakill) are multiplied by this number on death rampage.

1.0 means no change, 0.0 means remove sound completely, 0.5 to reduce radius to 50%%, 2.0 to double it, etc.

Frenzy bonus swing speed is multiplied by this number on death rampage.

1.0 means no change, 0.0 means remove the bonus completely, 0.5 to reduce it to 50%%, 2.0 to double it, etc.

Whether to enter into death rampage whenever you're about to die in combat.

You'll still end up dying, but at least you can take a few more zeds with you.

Whether to show debug actions (like trigger a loss of control event) in debug panel.

Debug panel can be enabled in Mod Options (Go to Options - Mods - scroll to "Bloodlust Overwhelming")
Whether it's possible to earn the trait.

How much of exertion to store every minute.

With 2 it'll take 50 minutes to store 100 exertion.

How much of the removed exertion is stored for later.

1.5 means you'll be later reliving 50%% more exertion than you actually stored.

How much of stored exertion to unleash back every minute.

With 3 it'll take ~30 minutes to unleash back 100 exertion.

Proportion of calories to burn based on unleashed exertion.

With 27, going from max calories (3700) to minimum (-2200) takes ~218 exertion,
or 100 exertion to go from max calories (3700) to weight loss territory (1000).

For reference, you'd have to keep swinging non-stop
for ~13 game world hours to go from 3700 to -2200,
or for ~6 game world hours to go from 3700 to 1000.

Proportion of hunger to add based on unleashed exertion.

0.3 means every 100 of exertion unleashed adds 30%% hunger.

Proportion of muscle strain to spread across your whole body based on unleashed exertion.

0.8 means every 100 of exertion unleashed adds 80 strain.

Proportion of thirst to add based on unleashed exertion.

0.4 means every 100 of exertion unleashed adds 40%% thirst.

Once you reach this level of exertion, all hits and kills will buffer some exertion.

50 is when second exertion moodle "High Exertion" appears.

Bloodlust change due to hits/kills is converted to exertion you'll buffer by multiplying by this.
Multiplier once you're at "Bloodlust For Exertion Buffering" and above.

Bloodlust change due to hits/kills is converted to exertion you'll buffer by multiplying by this.
Multiplier at 0 bloodlust, scaled linearly up to max as your bloodlust reaches "Bloodlust For Exertion Buffering".
Spending this much time in combat without hitting anyone will start increasing your bloodlust (If not in frenzy).

How much bloodlust to add every minute you aren't hitting anyone in combat.

With 3, it'll take 33 minutes to reach 100 bloodlust.
Whether your bloodlust will increase without fighting while driving.

How much of backlash to apply every in-game minute once frenzy ends.

Each instakill in frenzy adds 1.0 to backlash.

With 0.5 it'll take ~3.3 in-game hours to apply backlash for 100 instakills.

Maximum multiplier for the chance to lose weapon condition on hit while in frenzy.

It multiplies whatever your current chance to lose weapon durability is (base weapon chance + maintenance correction).
Ex. if you have 0 skills and weapon base chance is 10%%, 2.0 multiplier turns it into 20%%.

The multiplier smoothly increases starting from 1.0 to this value as bloodlust rises, reaching the set multiplier at 100%% bloodlust.
Every generic hit increases this much bloodlust in frenzy.
How much bloodlust to increase/decrease when you get hit by a zombie in frenzy.
In frenzy, getting hit with this much bloodlust will instakill the attacker and push back other zombies around.

How much damage to deal to an attacker when you get hit in frenzy.

Max zombie health is 2.0, so 2 damage will instakill whoever attacked you.
Frenzy Hurt Revenge Knock Down Chance
Percentage of zombies that will be knocked down when you get hit in frenzy.
Zombies within this many tiles to player will be pushed back when you get hit in frenzy.
Maximum number of zombies pushed back when you get hit in frenzy.

Zombies this many tiles away will be attracted to player in frenzy that just got hit.

For reference, shout sound radius is 30. See pzwiki.net/wiki/Noise

How much damage to additionally spread evenly to nearby zombies while instakilling in frenzy.

Max zombie health is 2.0.
Maximum tiles from instakilled zombie in which others will be affected.

How much calories will be burned for each instakill in frenzy.

With 90, going from max calories (3700) to minimum (-2200) takes 65 instakills,
or 30 instakills to go from max calories (3700) to weight loss territory (1000).

For reference, you'd have to keep swinging non-stop
for ~13 game world hours to go from 3700 to -2200,
or for ~6 game world hours to go from 3700 to 1000.

How much fatigue will be added for each instakill in frenzy.

With 2.5 it'll take ~40 instakills for 100%% fatigue.

How much hunger will be added for each instakill in frenzy.

With 3.33 it'll take ~30 instakills for 100%% hunger.

How much muscle strain will be spread across your whole body for each instakill in frenzy.

One body part can hold 100 strain.

How much thirst will be added for each instakill in frenzy.

With 5 it'll take ~20 instakills for 100%% thirst.
Maximum number of zombies affected by area damage.
Every generic kill increases this much bloodlust in frenzy.
Every hit with knives increases this much bloodlust in frenzy.
Every kill with knives increases this much bloodlust in frenzy.
Frenzy Per Minute Decay In Combat

How much frenzy bloodlust to reduce in combat.

Note that this applies to progress towards frenzy (the bloodlust you reduced while at 0).
Frenzy Per Minute Decay Out Of Combat

How much frenzy bloodlust to reduce out of combat.

Note that this applies to progress towards frenzy (the bloodlust you reduced while at 0).
Every ranged hit (with firearms) increases this much bloodlust in frenzy.
Every ranged kill (with firearms) increases this much bloodlust in frenzy.
Every hit with sharp weapons (spears, axes, blades) increases this much bloodlust in frenzy.

Defines how to decay bloodiness freshness.

It acts more like "Fresh Bloodiness" - same as bloodiness, but decays with time.
It's tracked separately, and no actual bloodiness is removed.

In "Individual" mode same bloodiness would decay in ~2 hours.
